title: Costa Concordia: route deviation, hull breach, flooding, blackout, list, and evacuation-state failure
summary: Costa Concordia is encoded as a navigation/damage-stability/evacuation-state case: the investigative-body surface records an intentional tourist-course approach, collision with Le Scole, blackout and multi-compartment flooding, a large passenger/crew population, victims, and evacuation/lifeboat constraints under list.
